continuum_yaml:
geometry:
  s_s: 0.002
  s_a: 0.048
  s_c: 0.024
  h_bc: 0.0064
  h_de: 0.009
  theta_a_max_rad: 3.141592653589793
  theta_c_max_rad: 1.5707963267948966
  d_min_m: 0.0
  d_max_m: 0.255
  # Robot frame: +X right, +Y down, +Z forward/insertion.
  base_offset_m: [0.0, -0.207, 0.4402]
  use_sheath: false

ik:
  task_mode: pos_z
  lambda_damping: 0.008
  alpha: 1.0
  pos_tol_m: 0.0002
  dir_tol: 0.001
  ori_tol_rad: 0.0005
  max_inner_steps: 8
  jacobian_eps: [0.001, 0.005, 0.005, 0.005, 0.005]
  position_weight: 1.0
  direction_weight: 0.8
  orientation_weight: 0.1
  line_search_steps: 4
  gradient_fallback_step: 0.01
  # Matches the newer MuJoCo teleop IK: no hard per-step IK clipping.
  # Cartesian speed limits are still enforced by robot_interface.yaml.
  step_limit_enabled: false
  # Conservative fallback if step_limit_enabled is set true.
  max_delta_u: [0.0003, 0.0025, 0.0025, 0.0025, 0.0025]

actuation:
  # Matched to tdrc_robot_system/scripts/hardware/interactive_pmac_joint_test.py.
  hole_radius_m: 0.00215
  spool_diameter_m: 0.012
  # Public joint phi -> tendon-plane phi; inverse feedback uses the same signs.
  phi_a_sign: -1
  phi_c_sign: -1
  # Hardware observation (2026-09-21): phi_a=0 bends toward WORLD -Z;
  # phi_c=0 bends toward WORLD +Z. Recorded only: no zero-angle offset applied.

control:
  update_hz: 50
  pvt_velocity_from_diff: true
interface_yaml:
# EXPERIMENTAL: axis-5 short-motion trials passed; full Omega integration is pending.
# Requires live Axis5_MaxStep=5023 at 50 Hz; hardware tests used temporary 6500.
# This file is opt-in. The default robot_interface.yaml is unchanged.
# Framework-independent robot interface contract used before the LeRobot adapter.
control_hz: 50

# External command frame: +X right, +Y forward/insertion, +Z up.
# Internal IK frame remains +X right, +Y down, +Z forward/insertion.
# External standard right-handed XYZ command -> existing internal IK frame.
# Internal frame remains +X right, +Y down, +Z insertion.

# world = [X, Y, Z]

# zxy
#  ↓
# local = [Z, X, Y]

frame:
  translation_map: zxy
  translation_signs: [-1, -1, 1]
  # Angular vectors use the same basis change as XYZ vectors:
  # Current mapping: world [X, Y, Z] -> internal [-Z, X, Y].
  # Hardware WORLD-axis calibration is still pending; preserve these values.
  rotation_map: zxy
  rotation_signs: [1, 1, 1]

initial_position:
  # Axis 5 is manually homed before use. Preserve displacement from that zero
  # instead of treating each teleoperation startup as insertion d=0.
  insertion_zero_pulses: 0
  # capture_current preserves the current behavior: startup feedback becomes
  # the logical actuator zero for this run.
  #
  # For reproducible datasets, switch to configured_reference after the
  # reference position and tolerances have been physically validated.
  mode: capture_current
  # Recorded approximately straight pose; capture_current does not use it as zero.
  reference_pulses: [68887403, 502449050, -138990801, 404264370, 957431]
  reject_all_zero_feedback: true
  require_near_reference: false
  tolerance_pulses: null

execution:
  # Software anomaly stop, NOT a validated motor speed capability.
  # Checks rotary PVT cubic peak before submission; trip ends the session.
  rotary_target_stop_rad_s: 2.5
  # Logical insertion d speed budget, independent of WORLD X/Y/Z.
  # Candidate retained after short-motion and repeated-reversal trials.
  # Execution generates acceleration-bounded PVT segments; PMAC guards are separate.
  insertion_max_speed_m_s: 0.004
  insertion_max_accel_m_s2: 0.005
  # Host sampled abort threshold, not a replacement for PMAC protection.
  insertion_error_stop_m: 0.00005

command:
  # Tip pose offset from the configured neutral tip pose, robot XYZ.
  max_delta_m: [0.08, 0.05, 0.05]
  max_speed_m_s: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01]

  # Default teleoperation uses the complete 5-DOF IK task: translation plus
  # tip-axis direction. In the external/world frame, Ry maps to continuum Rz
  # (tool roll) and remains disabled.
  orientation_enabled: true
  # External/world rotations: Rx and Rz are enabled; Ry maps to the
  # continuum tool-axis roll and is disabled.
  # null removes the Rx/Rz command cap; 0 keeps Ry disabled.
  # IK geometry and execution limits remain; not every requested pose is reachable.
  max_rotation_delta_rad: [null, 0.0, null]
  max_angular_speed_rad_s: [0.5, 0.0, 0.5]

  deadband_m: 0.0003
  smooth_alpha: 0.5 # 平滑度 1.0 为关闭
